critical_findings.finding: New Call and Clear search are accessible icon controls, not guaranteed literal labels. New Call needs canUserCreateCalls; Clear search appears only after text entry. Capture DOM control boxes and review the actual image.
Address, geolocation, what3words, Plus Code and recipient/schedule fields follow the loaded department field policy. A location field existing in source does not prove the active policy offers it.
Set as Active Call selects this call locally. This action does not send personal responding status. Home has a separate View Call Details and Clear Active Call.
Route to Destination is conditional on a destination with coordinates. Routing invokes an external mapping application; do not open it in this fixture or claim navigation or physical travel.

Call Files lists and downloads/shares existing attachments. It contains no file upload control. Call Images separately offers photo/library selection and upload; camera and native sharing are unexercised.
The Check-In tab only renders on a timer-enabled call. Current CheckInTabPanel offers eligible checks and history; ToggleCallTimers is API-only, not a rendered timer-management screen.
Personnel/unit/PAR/hazmat/rotation/rehab choices depend on resolved eligible targets and current unit type. Do not force a target by changing crew or role assignments.
Contextual New Record is hidden unless Records.Field is enabled and the server catalog offers a definition for the current verified context.

Prefill only runs for a definition advertising SupportsPrefill. Keep on this device remains rendered but disabled when offline authoring is unavailable; source presence does not prove durable browser storage.

Draft/Returned records with supported schema render Save, Submit for review, attestation and Finalize. Finalize remains disabled until attestation; the server enforces authority. DraftReference is a legitimate draft identifier; it is not a failed final number.
Attachments are record-specific after a server record exists, editable only in Draft/Returned and hidden when AllowAttachments is false. Amend, void and approve remain web-first, with no action here.
Read feed now is readiness-gated and can contact an external system. View existing status only; credentials, reconciliation decisions and provider reads are outside this capture scope.

Trade Accept/Decline require incoming + Open + MyState Open; outgoing offer selection, cancellation and supervisory review have distinct gates. These are real rendered actions but remain unexercised in the captured unsent form.
Work-order Steps are read-only Text rows, not interactive completion checkboxes. Assignment acceptance requires CanWrite and CanAccept; transition inputs follow the server transitions/requirements.
Cancel Attendance uses native Alert with no browser confirmation fallback in this source. The saved signup is real; the cancel button was viewed without a demonstrated cancellation.
Native checklist storage uses encrypted envelopes and device-only SecureStore keys; the browser uses memory only. Same-session resume does not prove reload/crash/offline persistence.

Responder supports time approval only when access.CanApprove and a submitted report exist. Unit disables approval in its app capabilities. This captured report is unsigned Draft, so no approval is demonstrated.

F-42 panel drafts from deployment time reports and validates through the API. The displayed Not ready for the portal is a real validation failure, not successful portal submission. Submission remains a separate audited manual web handoff.
